description: Select an earlier training donor by fixed scaled Euclidean distance on as-of environment, passport and full-grid terrain descriptors. Choose the largest if distances tie. In the spatial diagnostic donors can be from the frozen same-date training set. Each eligible donor has its own centered residual Ridge using the frozen features and the shared physics level. Largest-donor control uses the same candidate pool and models. Use full-grid centering. Never use held labels, diagnostic summaries or target thickness to choose a donor.
